identity.title: Make Runtime v3 Observatory local HTTPS and report bound control address

values.goal: Repair the integrated Runtime v3 local control and Observatory path without a gateway or hard-coded port.
values.required_outcome: Runtime v3 serves its control API through native TLS and all discovery data reflects the actual bound socket.
declared_scope: HTML Observatory local HTTPS documentation and validation
authority_boundary: No external TLS gateway or sidecar
No committed private key or automatic trust-store mutation
Runtime v3 remains explicit opt-in and Runtime v2 remains default
